sheet = 'Allowed assignments'
rows = data_rows(sheet, {'L':'string', 'M':'string', 'N':'number'}, 812, 820)
data = [cells(sheet, f'L{r}:N{r}')[0] for r in rows]
tasks = list(set(r[0] for r in data))
workers = list(set(r[1] for r in data))
cost_map = {(r[0], r[1]): r[2] for r in data}
min_cost = 999999
for p in itertools.permutations(workers, len(tasks)):
    possible = True
    c = 0
    for i, t in enumerate(tasks):
        pair = (t, p[i])
        if pair in cost_map:
            c += cost_map[pair]
        else:
            possible = False
            break
    if possible:
        min_cost = min(min_cost, c)
result = min_cost
